name: quantconnect
description: QuantConnect LEAN algorithms. Python class inheriting QCAlgorithm. Free backtesting on QC cloud, live deploy via subscription.

indicators: indicator.IsReady — gate on this, never use IsReady==False values
ordering: self.SetHoldings(symbol, weight) — target portfolio weight, auto-calculates order size
scheduling: DateRules.WeekStart / MonthStart / MonthEnd for periodic rebalancing
framework_style: Alpha model emits Insight(symbol, direction, magnitude, period).
RiskManagementModel can override targets (e.g. drawdown halt).

code_skeleton:
from AlgorithmImports import *

class StrategyAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2018, 1, 1)
        self.SetEndDate(2023, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(100000)
        self.SetBrokerageModel(BrokerageName.InteractiveBrokersBrokerage, AccountType.Margin)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity('SPY', Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.sma_fast = self.SMA(self.spy, 20, Resolution.Daily)
        self.sma_slow = self.SMA(self.spy, 100, Resolution.Daily)
        self.SetWarmUp(100)

        self.Schedule.On(self.DateRules.EveryDay(self.spy),
                         self.TimeRules.AfterMarketOpen(self.spy, 15),
                         self.Rebalance)

    def Rebalance(self):
        if self.IsWarmingUp or not self.sma_fast.IsReady or not self.sma_slow.IsReady:
            return
        long_signal = self.sma_fast.Current.Value > self.sma_slow.Current.Value
        target = 1.0 if long_signal else 0.0
        self.SetHoldings(self.spy, target)

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        pass
anti_patterns: Forgetting SetWarmUp — first bars feed garbage to indicators, trades fire on noise.
Universe selection inside OnData instead of CoarseSelectionFunction — latency balloon.
Calling History() every bar to refetch data — slow; cache via indicators or rolling windows.
Using datetime.now() — LEAN replays historical time, must use self.Time.
Market-on-close orders without time-in-force awareness — they may not fill at expected prices.
Hard-coding a single symbol for a framework that was designed to scale — use universes.
Ignoring reality modeling — LEAN has realistic slippage/fees by default; don't override without reason.
Rolling your own order sizing when SetHoldings() handles it correctly.
submission_requirements: Initialize() sets start/end/cash and registers securities.
OnData(Slice) or scheduled callbacks handle trading logic.
Import only via `from AlgorithmImports import *` (not ad-hoc pip installs).
All data fetched via self.AddEquity/AddFuture/etc — no urllib/requests.
past_round_notes: Pure trend-following on SPY + long-duration bonds (TLT) via SMA crossover beats most sophisticated ideas on risk-adjusted metrics over 10+ year backtests.
Intraday strategies often fail due to ignored liquidity / reality modeling — fees eat intraday edges.
Framework-based algorithms (Alpha + PortfolioConstruction + Risk + Execution) usually outperform monolithic OnData implementations at scale.
Universe rotation (top-N by momentum, rebalanced monthly) is a durable baseline.
Risk overlays (halt new positions if rolling 30d DD > 5%) improve Sortino significantly.
prompt_addendum: Context: QuantConnect LEAN. Output a Python algorithm subclassing QCAlgorithm with Initialize() and OnData() (or scheduled callbacks). Always use `from AlgorithmImports import *`. Always call SetWarmUp and gate on indicator.IsReady. Prefer SetHoldings for portfolio targets. DO NOT use Backtrader. DO NOT print STRATENGINE_STATS. DO NOT make network calls. For multi-asset, use universes (CoarseSelectionFunction), not hard-coded ticker lists.
